rotation.marker: Cycle 2 closes · Thanksgiving Thu 11/26 — holiday coverage set at the nightly meetings

openingMessage: Success is peace of mind, which is a direct result of self-satisfaction in knowing you did your best to become the best you are capable of becoming.
openingWhy: There's a quiet that rides home with you when every reading was real and the location's better than you found it. No shortcut has ever produced that feeling, and no paycheck covers not having it.
leadershipThought: Major incidents often start with small oversights. Someone assumed. Someone skipped a step. Someone thought, 'It'll probably be okay.' PSMS exists because consistency reduces surprises.

fieldNews.headline: The whole crew — November is the best month of the fall
fieldNews.detail: Matt Croom's mid-month audit: 94.6% of forms complete in November, up from 82% in August. Trailer inspections at 98.8%. Seventeen techs at 100% for the week.

fieldNews.headline: Justin Pack — seven days running with nothing to fix
fieldNews.detail: Hughes #1, Friday through Thursday: complete H2S daily each day, both cascade fields, every photo from that morning.

fieldNews.headline: Thursday's clean list — twelve techs with nothing to fix
fieldNews.detail: Morales, Marquez-Salazar, Fontenot, Haugh, Soto, Ellis, Larry Taylor, Rojo, Bailey, Drake, McCarter and Henigan: complete forms, same-day photos.

fieldNews.headline: Joseph Popillion — held the job and used stop work over a leaking casing
fieldNews.detail: Shull Crawford 15OO 115H, Monday: gas showed when the valves opened. Hold point, a plan, the right people notified, and the disconnect stopped until the crew was comfortable.

fieldNews.headline: Ralph Forbes — clean trailer inspection at 5:03 AM, before the drive
fieldNews.detail: Wednesday, trailer 139: complete and clean before the Highway 176 crash. Doing it right can't stop a reckless driver, but it's why we never stop doing it right.

fieldNews.headline: Andrew Bailey — trailer 602 covered three days running
fieldNews.detail: Wednesday: three trailer inspections and two air jobs, complete throughout.

fieldNews.headline: Clean board — no open watch items this week
fieldNews.detail: Nothing carried in from last week. See a hazard? Flag it on your OWL form and it lands here the same evening.

todaysChallenge: Pick one thing today you'd only do if someone was checking — the monitor calibration, the trailer form, the tube count — and do it like the client was standing there. Nobody watching is the test.
todaysChallengeSubtext: “The true test of a man's character is what he does when no one is watching.” — John Wooden
